propositions: Eleven near-duplicate CLI verbs (exists, format, check-ac, clarity-check, quality-check, tag, untag, get-file-impact, get-verify-commands, list-descendants, session-logs) are removed via hard cutover with no aliases; dispatch exits 2 with removal hint for all 16 spellings (11 new + 5 historical).
Removed spellings are registered in _REMOVED_SPELLINGS dict and _REMOVED_SIMPLE_CLI_ALIASES frozenset; wants_help() and dispatch propagate removal hints via stderr after argparse error.

Five golden-path verbs absorb the removed verbs: check (gates; modes --ac/--clarity/default), resolve (lookups; gains --display[=MODE]), show (reads; gains --field NAME), deps (reads; gains --descendants), list (reads; gains --limit N).

Handlers resolve_cli, check_ac_cli, clarity_check_cli, quality_check_cli keep current signatures; check_cli is new 3-arg entry that parses mode and delegates; resolve_cli signature changes from (argv, tracker) to (argv, tracker, repo_root); resolve route adapter flips to argv_tracker_root.

recent_session_logs_state drops private sort and reuses sort_states(logs, '-created')[:limit] so library, MCP, CLI share one ordering rule with ticket_id tiebreak on equal created_at; list --type=session_log --sort=-created --limit=N returns N newest.
All 11 removed verb call sites across 16 CI-run test files, 2 scripts, and docs/output-schemas.md retarget to new spellings; help, reference, exit-codes, and schema descriptions regenerated.
